title: Maikura Inventory Expansion
description: Adds configurable extra inventory space with customizable size up to 54 slots.
body:
# Maikura Inventory Expansion

Adds configurable extra inventory space directly to the vanilla inventory screen.

## Features

* Adds extra inventory slots to the player inventory
* Configurable from 3×3 to 6×9 extra slots
* Integrated directly into the vanilla inventory GUI
* Per-player inventory storage
* Death-safe storage
* Mod Menu configuration support
* Items stored in hidden slots are not deleted when inventory size is reduced

## Configuration

The extra inventory size can be customized from:

* Width: 3 to 6 slots
* Height: 3 to 9 slots

This allows inventory sizes ranging from 3×3 (9 slots) up to 6×9 (54 slots).

## Requirements

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Mod Menu (optional)

## Notes

When the inventory size is reduced, items stored outside the visible range are hidden but remain safely stored. Expanding the inventory again will make those items visible.

Inventory data is stored per player and remains available after rejoining the world.
